description: Plaud ingest trigger was not fired during boot sequence. Boot Phase 2 requires launching Plaud ingest as a background fire-and-forget Agent alongside other parallel tasks. The step was silently omitted — no report of 'skipped' or 'failed' was surfaced in the briefing. David caught the omission.
correction: Plaud ingest must be triggered in Phase 2 of every boot, in parallel with other background tasks. It must report completed, nothing to surface, or failed — reason. Silence is not acceptable.
systemic_fix: Add an explicit checklist verification to the boot synthesis step that confirms each Phase 2 task was either fired or reported as unavailable before the briefing is delivered.
